statement: The repo's ruff lint config only enables the N (naming) and I (isort) rule sets, so rules like builtin shadowing are not checked.
quote: Ruff only checks `N` (naming) and `I` (isort), so no builtin-shadowing issues.

statement: In typer command signatures, the codebase adds a trailing underscore to parameter names that would shadow Python builtins (e.g. `open_` for the `--open` option).
quote: Note the codebase uses trailing underscore (`open_`) to avoid builtin shadowing.

statement: The `snow sql` command is defined in src/snowcli/cli/sql/commands.py, which delegates to SqlManager in src/snowcli/cli/sql/manager.py (built on SqlExecutionMixin in src/snowcli/cli/common/sql_execution.py). It is registered as a single command through plugin_spec.py.

Shared unit-test fixtures are in tests/testing_utils/fixtures.py, which includes a mock connection whose execute_string/execute_stream record the queries. Usage-error assertions come from tests/testing_utils/result_assertions.py (assert_that_result_is_usage_error).
